item.title: Implement cursor pagination for GET /items
item.brief: Implement the shared cursor pagination protocol for GET /items. Add API support for optional limit (integer 1..100, default 20) and opaque cursor, preserve ordering by id, return {items, next_cursor} with null on the final page, and return status 400 with {error: ...} for invalid limit or cursor. Update the repository README to document the new request and response behavior. Run python3 -m unittest and keep all tests passing. Commit the completed change on this repository's assigned branch.
